Timelapsing/Warping in New York City

Andy CASA, UCL East

Timelapsing/warping is a series of techniques that when combined can create unique view of the urban scene.

Daniele Quatrini of http://www.lowbudgetmiracle.it/ (seems to be under construction) have used a variety of timelapse/warps clips set to 'An Open Letter to New York' by The Beastie Boys to create the movie below:
Timelapsing/warping in New York City from Daniele Quatrini on Vimeo.
The mix of clips and the choice of scenes make for a view of New York beyond the normal city timelapses - we now have a dedicated thread to view all the urban timelapse movies on digital urban...
